title: 第十七章 牛嚼牡丹第十八章 最是难负美人心
lines: 相比朱莹开出的清单，此番赵国公府送来的东西只有多，没有少。
光是大小姐的各色衣裳行头，便有整整六个箱子。其中，今年新裁的夏衣四箱，以防天气突然转凉时，以备不时之需的去岁旧秋衣两箱——当然，虽说旧，朱莹一次都还没上过身。
至于冬衣，用湛金和流银的话来说，一则是冬天还远，二则，若是真的入秋，大小姐的秋衣尚且要裁缝过来重新量身定做，更何况是冬衣？
而朱莹点名要的那些书，那些器物首饰等等，又是八个箱子。所有这些，装了三辆马车。
所以，在重新整理箱笼的时候，湛金和流银两个丫头不由眉头紧紧拧起，只觉得这张家正房实在是太小，柜子实在是太少……总而言之一句话，根本没地儿放这么多东西！
然而，朱莹早就暗中警告过她们，不许挑剔抱怨，她们也只能在肚子里生闷气。只觉得那个对大小姐百般赔笑讨好的吴氏，一点都没有当家主母的样子。
这种不满的怨气，直到门外一声咳嗽，紧跟着那个仿佛给这昏暗屋子带来光的少年进门，方才无影无踪。饶是她们知道这位小郎君不过是乡间长大的，却依旧不禁贪看那容光，许久才醒悟到这样盯着人看，实在是对不住自家小姐。
“阿寿，怎么这么晚才回来！”
一直在努力安抚朱莹的吴氏总算是松了一口大气。她嗔怪地瞪了进屋的张寿一眼，却没等他开口辩解，便直截了当地说：“你好好陪着莹莹说会话，我去厨房让刘婶盛甜汤来！”
见吴氏说完就走，一点没给自己拒绝的机会，张寿忍不住擦了擦额头汗珠。可下一刻，他便只听朱莹吩咐道：“湛金，还不快去拧块湿巾来，看他一头的汗！”
湛金连忙答应一声，可等到用盆中井水浸湿了软巾拧干，又送到了张寿面前，听到那一声多谢，她瞥见准姑爷那张清俊的脸，不禁面红耳赤，甚至顾不得答话便退到了里屋，假装整理东西。可随之她就听到了朱莹那清脆的笑声。
“这丫头，跑那么快干什么！流银，你快去，给他送杯茶。”
擦完脸的张寿听到朱莹这吩咐，见流银送了茶给他之后，果然同样是一溜烟奔到了里间，再也不肯出来。简直又好气又好笑。
这么个胆大妄为的大小姐，怎么有这么容易害羞的丫头？
他捧着茶找了张椅子坐下，喝了一口之后，他就不禁心中一动。下一刻，就只听朱莹问道：“怎么样，这今年的社前茶如何？亏得湛金和流银细心，把太后赏给我的新茶也捎了来。”
“社前茶？”张寿不禁暗自踌躇。所谓社前，指的是春社之前，也就是立春第五个戊日祭春之前出产的茶，大多甚至在春分左右采摘，足足比清明要早半个月。这个时分，茶叶细嫩，产量极少，比明前更加珍贵，所谓头茬贡茶，便是如此。
他细细再品，心中不禁有了计较：“贡茶求早，社前茶产量少，仅供上用，自然是珍品。”
朱莹本意不是炫耀，可见张寿处之淡然，她却又有些不高兴，当下不服气地问：“那你说什么茶更好？”
“我这乡间大多是陈茶，好茶根本就没喝过，哪里知道茶叶好坏。”张寿打了个哈哈，仿若不以为意地说，“再说我平常也不怎么喜好喝茶，那些茶叶也就是用来解渴而已。给我喝好茶，那是暴殄天物，浪费了。”
朱莹心中大乐，当下她便极其豪气地说：“什么浪费不浪费，茶叶就是用来喝的，放着可惜了！”
“不少品种的社前茶和明前雨前不同，当年泡茶，口感并不是最好。相反，有时候要放三五年才能出香，那时候喝，齿颊留香，更胜新茶。”张寿虽这么说，但却一口气将茶水饮尽，随即又笑道，“而似我这般牛饮社前新茶的，不免要被人讥笑是牛嚼牡丹的蠢物了。”
他正这么说，刚刚躲进去的湛金和流银两个丫头，竟是突然双双从东边书房探出了头。流银性子活泼一些，却是抿嘴笑道：“寿公子这习惯和大小姐真像，她也说，喝茶只是为了解渴。不管什么茶，喝起来味道都差不多。”
虽说流银这是帮衬自己，朱大小姐还是瞪了她一眼：“要你多嘴！”
然而，她脸上那笑吟吟的表情，却暴露出了她极好的心情。
“往年的那些贡茶，二哥说外头一堆人当宝贝，有时候竟从我这偷了出去，交换给那些趋之若鹜的人家，转头再打了精巧首饰拿来讨好我，我也睁一只眼闭一只眼了，反正那社前茶我才喝不出好来，平日就丢在哪个罐子里，也就湛金和流银觉得珍贵，特意带了过来！”
说着，朱莹便冲着张寿一笑：“没想到还真的有人和我一样牛嚼牡丹！”
张寿见朱莹还对他眨了眨眼睛，一副终于找到知己的样子，这一刻，他只觉得自己刚刚那一片自黑的苦心全都泡了汤。
我以为名门千金必定各种讲究，所以才想把自己打扮成不解风雅的俗人一个，谁知道会弄巧成拙！
想到自己在徐木匠后院听到的那些对话，张寿也不接话茬，把茶盏往旁边高几上一搁，这才饶有兴致地看着两个大丫头。直到将她们看得心头小鹿乱撞，他才笑吟吟地问道：“你们今天既然遭遇那位赵妈妈拦路，把她和那几个护卫带了过来，动静岂不是闹得很大？”
湛金和流银对视一眼，见朱莹没有阻止，最终，性子更稳重的湛金就开口说道：“是闹得不小，大小姐在京城名气大得很，今天听说是咱们家的事，围了里三层外三层的人，都是看热闹的。所以李妈妈才没当场拿下赵妈妈那几个人，而是答应带了她过来。”
“哦？”张寿若有所思地摸了摸下巴，这才问出了另一个问题，“既然你家大小姐艳冠群芳，那么她在京城岂不是倾慕者无数？”
content_en:
Compared with the list drawn by Zhu Ying, the things sent by Zhao Guogong's mansion this time were more, not less.
There are six full boxes of the eldest lady’s various clothes and accessories alone. Among them, there are four boxes of newly cut summer clothes this year, just in case the weather turns cold suddenly, and two boxes of old autumn clothes from last year to prepare for emergencies. Of course, even though they are old, Zhu Ying has never had to wear clothes once.
As for winter clothes, in the words of Zhan Jin and Liu Yin, firstly, winter is still far away, and secondly, if autumn really comes, the eldest lady’s autumn clothes will need to be re-tailored by a tailor, let alone winter clothes?
The books, utensils, jewelry, etc. that Zhu Ying asked for by name were eight more boxes. All this, loaded into three carriages.
Therefore, when they were rearranging the boxes and cages, the two girls Zhan Jin and Liu Yin couldn't help but frown tightly. They just felt that the main room of the house was too small and there were too few cabinets... In short, there was no room to put so many things!
However, Zhu Ying had secretly warned them not to criticize and complain, and they could only sulk in their stomachs. I just felt that Mrs. Wu, who was trying to please the eldest lady in every possible way, did not look like a matron at all.
This dissatisfaction and resentment disappeared until there was a cough outside the door, followed by the young man who seemed to bring light to this dark room. Even though they knew that this young gentleman only grew up in the countryside, they still couldn't help but stare at that radiant face. It took them a long time to realize that they were really sorry for their young lady by staring at people like this.
"Ah Shou, why are you back so late!"
Wu, who had been trying to comfort Zhu Ying, finally breathed a sigh of relief. She glared at Zhang Shou who came into the room angrily, but before he could open his mouth to defend, she said bluntly: "You have a good conversation with Yingying, and I'll go to the kitchen and ask Aunt Liu to bring sweet soup!"
Seeing that Wu left after saying that, without giving himself a chance to refuse, Zhang Shou couldn't help but wipe the sweat from his forehead. But the next moment, he just listened to Zhu Ying's instructions: "Zhan Jin, why don't you quickly go and twist a wet wipe? Look at the sweat on his head!"
Zhan Jin quickly agreed, but when she soaked the soft towel with well water in the basin and wrung it out, she sent it to Zhang Shou. When she heard the thank you and caught a glimpse of her uncle-in-law's handsome face, she couldn't help but blush. She didn't even bother to answer and retreated to the back room, pretending to pack things. But then she heard Zhu Ying's crisp laughter.
"What is this girl doing running so fast! Liuyin, go quickly and give him a cup of tea."
Zhang Shou, who had finished wiping his face, heard Zhu Ying's instructions and saw that after Liu Yin gave him tea, he also ran into the inner room and never came out again. It's so infuriating and funny.
How could such a bold young lady be so easily shy?
He found a chair and sat down with the tea in his hands. After taking a sip, he couldn't help but feel something in his heart. The next moment, Zhu Ying asked: "How is it? How is the Sheqian tea this year? Thanks to Zhan Jin and Liu Yin's carefulness, they also brought the new tea given to me by the Queen Mother."
"Tea in front of the society?" Zhang Shou couldn't help but hesitated secretly. The so-called Sheqian refers to the tea produced before the Spring Society, that is, before the Spring Festival on the fifth day of spring. Most of them are picked around the Spring Equinox, half a month earlier than the Qingming Festival. At this time, the tea leaves are tender and the yield is very small. It is more precious than before the Ming Dynasty. This is the so-called first crop tribute tea.
He tasted it carefully, and couldn't help but have a suspicion in his mind: "Please ask for tribute tea early. The output of Sheqian tea is small and is only for consumption. It is naturally a treasure."
Zhu Ying's intention was not to show off, but it was obvious that Zhang Shou was indifferent, but she was a little unhappy. She asked unconvincedly: "Then what tea is better?"
"Most of the tea in my countryside is old tea. I have never drunk good tea. How can I know whether the tea is good or bad." Zhang Shou laughed and said as if he didn't care, "Besides, I don't like drinking tea very much. Those tea leaves are only used to quench my thirst. Give me good tea, it is a waste of money."
Zhu Ying was so happy that she immediately said with great pride: "There is no waste. Tea is for drinking. It would be a pity to leave it alone!"
"Many varieties of Sheqian tea are different from Mingqian Yuqian. Tea brewed in the past does not have the best taste. On the contrary, sometimes it takes three to five years to be fragrant. When you drink it at that time, the fragrance will linger on your teeth and cheeks, which is better than new tea." Although Zhang Shou said this, he drank all the tea in one breath, and then laughed, "And someone like me who drinks the new Sheqian tea will inevitably be ridiculed as a peony-chewing fool."
Just as he said this, the two girls Zhan Jin and Liu Yin who had just hid in suddenly poked their heads out of the east study room. Liuyin was more lively, but he pursed his lips and said with a smile: "Master Shou's habits are really similar to those of the eldest lady. She also said that drinking tea is just to quench her thirst. No matter what kind of tea, it tastes the same."
Although Liuyin was trying to help herself, Miss Zhu still glared at her: "I want you to talk more!"
However, the smiling expression on her face revealed her excellent mood.
"My second brother said that those tribute teas from previous years were regarded as treasures by a lot of people outside. Sometimes they were stolen from me and exchanged with those who flocked to them. Then they turned around and made exquisite jewelry to please me. I turned a blind eye. Anyway, I couldn't drink the tea in front of the house. I just threw it in a jar on weekdays. Zhanjin and Liuyin thought it was precious, so they brought it here specially!"
After saying that, Zhu Ying smiled at Zhang Shou: "I didn't expect that there would be someone who chewed peonies as well as me!"
Zhang Shou saw Zhu Ying blinking at him, as if he had finally found his soulmate. At this moment, he just felt that all the painstaking efforts he had just made to blame himself were in vain.
I thought that a daughter from a famous family must be very particular about everything, so I wanted to dress myself up as a commoner who doesn't understand elegance. Who knew it would be self-defeating!
Thinking of the conversations he heard in Carpenter Xu's backyard, Zhang Shou didn't answer the question, put the tea cup on the high table next to him, and then looked at the two girls with interest. It wasn't until he saw them that his heart was pounding, that he asked with a smile: "Since you encountered that Mother Zhao blocking the road today and brought her and those guards over, wouldn't it make a big noise?"
Zhan Jin and Liu Yin looked at each other and saw that Zhu Ying did not stop them. Finally, Zhan Jin, who had a more stable temperament, said: "It was quite a fuss. The eldest lady is very famous in the capital. I heard today that it was our family's business. People from the three floors outside and inside gathered around to watch the fun. That's why Mother Li did not take down Mother Zhao's people on the spot, but agreed to bring her over."
"Oh?" Zhang Shou touched his chin thoughtfully, and then asked another question, "Since your eldest lady is the most beautiful, doesn't she have countless admirers in the capital?"
title_en: Chapter 17: Cow Chewing Peonies Chapter 18: It’s Hard to Disappoint Beauty’s Heart
